items.name: ASTRON
items.description: ASTRON is the Netherlands Institute for Radio Astronomy, ASTRON is part of the institutes organisation of NWO. Our mission is to make discoveries in radio astronomy happen. We do this by developing new and innovative technologies, operating world-class radio astronomy facilities, and pursuing fundamental astronomical research.

items.name: NWO
items.description: NWO investeert jaarlijks bijna 1 miljard euro in nieuwsgierigheidsgedreven onderzoek, onderzoek gericht op maatschappelijke uitdagingen en in onderzoeksinfrastructuur.

items.name: ESA-ESTEC
items.description: ESA’s European Space Research and Technology Centre (ESTEC) is the technical heart of ESA, providing test facilities and engineering support for European missions.

items.name: MBO College Airport
items.description: MBO College Airport conducts research, education and innovation activities related to aerospace and/or unmanned systems, collaborating with industry and public partners.

items.name: Netherlands Aerospace Centre NLR
items.description: The Netherlands Aerospace Centre (NLR) conducts applied research for aerospace, advancing safety, sustainability and innovation for industry and government.

items.name: The Hague University
items.description: The Hague University conducts research, education and innovation activities related to aerospace and/or unmanned systems, collaborating with industry and public partners.

items.name: TNO Space & Systems Engineering
items.description: TNO advances space technology through applied research, including instruments, optics and system engineering for satellite missions.

items.name: TU Delft Faculty of Aerospace Engineering
items.description: TU Delft’s Faculty of Aerospace Engineering is one of Europe’s largest aerospace faculties, covering aeronautics and astronautics across education and research.

items.name: TU Delft Space Institute
items.description: The TU Delft Space Institute connects space-related research groups across the university, focusing on satellites, instruments and space missions.
